description: A wooden mancala board sits on the table, with several clear blue and green glass marbles in the cups on the right side. The right hand repeatedly pinches a marble from one cup, lifts it slightly, and drops it into the next cup as it moves along the row toward the rightmost end, continuing this pick-and-place sowing motion; the left hand rests near the bottom edge and occasionally shifts slightly without taking pieces, so the marbles are a right-hand object throughout.
